items.title: SBI Data Breach Claim – Hackers Allegedly Claim Access to 3.75 Lakh Users’ Database
items.description: An unverified SBI data breach claim alleges that a threat actor named Siriusim posted customer records and banking documents online. The claimed dataset contains 375,000 CSV rows and 2,722 PDF files, but those figures do not establish that 3.75 lakh unique customers were affected. items.title: One Hacker Uses AI Agents to Breach Over 100 Company Websites for Just $5,000
items.description: A Chinese-speaking hacker used AI agents to break into more than 100 company websites while spending an estimated $5,000 on AI tokens, according to a Reuters investigation in October. The operation shows how one person can direct software to carry out complex attacks with little ongoing human input. items.title: Claude AI Detects Hidden Crypto Miner While Building Temperature Monitor App on Mac
items.description: An ordinary coding task led to an unexpected security discovery when Claude Code reportedly found a hidden cryptocurrency miner on a developer’s Mac. The AI assistant was building a temperature monitoring app when unusually high sensor readings prompted it to investigate CPU activity.
